title: Prawn and fennel tomato stew
summary: Prawn and fennel tomato stew is a italian dinner built around raw king prawns and fennel, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Warm the oil and soften the onion for Prawn and fennel tomato stew. Stir in the garlic, ginger and spices until they smell fragrant.
steps.tip: If the spices look dusty, give them a minute in the oil before any liquid goes in.

steps.instruction: Add raw king prawns and cook until it loses its raw look. Pour in the tomatoes or coconut and fennel.
Simmer gently, lid ajar, until cherry tomatoes is tender and the sauce coats a spoon. Add a splash of water if it sticks.
steps.tip: Taste Prawn and fennel tomato stew before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Taste for salt and acid, then rest the pan for a couple of minutes before serving Prawn and fennel tomato stew.  Serve with the rice, simmered in salted water until tender.
